cityKey.label: The Dhaka City band
cityKey.help: Which delivery band is inside the city. Every area of the official city-corporation map below is in it.

subAreaKey.label: The sub-area band
subAreaKey.help: Which delivery band holds your own sub-area list (for example Gazipur, Savar, Narayanganj).

outsideKey.label: The outside band
outsideKey.help: Which delivery band is everywhere else in the country: one flat charge.

cityCorporations.label: City corporations inside the city band
cityCorporations.help: The city is the official map of these city corporations, nothing else. Dhaka: DNCC and DSCC.

searchLimit.label: Places shown in the admin search
searchLimit.help: How many places the admin's place search shows at most (adding a place to the sub-area list).

cacheSeconds.label: Re-check the area list every (seconds)
cacheSeconds.help: The shop keeps the national area list in memory and looks for a newer list this often. A new list is only loaded when it has really changed.

settleMs.label: Wait after typing stops (milliseconds)
settleMs.help: At checkout the address is read only once the customer stops typing for this long (or leaves the field). Nothing is decided while he is still writing.

minWords.label: Words before a pause counts
minWords.help: A pause reads the address only once it has at least this many words; leaving the field always reads it.

minKeyChars.label: Shortest place name looked up (letters)
minKeyChars.help: Shorter words in an address are never taken for a place name.

numberLabels.label: Words before a house or road number
numberLabels.help: A 4-digit number right after one of these words (House, Road, Sector…) is a number in the address, not a postcode.

maxChars.label: Longest address line read (characters)
maxChars.help: A longer line is refused, so nobody can send the shop huge texts to read.

maxBodyBytes.label: Largest public delivery request (bytes)
maxBodyBytes.help: The checkout's address and phone look-ups are refused when they are bigger than this.

enabled.label: Address suggestions
enabled.help: While the customer types the area, show matching places with their district and delivery charge.

minChars.label: Letters before suggesting
minChars.help: How many letters the customer types before suggestions appear.

limit.label: Suggestions shown
limit.help: The most places shown at once while the customer types.
